title: Cymbopogon citratus essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Cymbopogon citratus essential oil is a fragrant oil derived from the leaves of the lemongrass plant, known for its fresh, citrusy aroma. It is widely used in herbalism for its calming and digestive properties, often employed to alleviate stress, anxiety, and gastrointestinal discomfort. This essential oil can be applied topically, inhaled, or diluted for internal use under professional guidance. It is valued for its potential to support respiratory health and promote relaxation. Its versatility makes it a popular choice in aromatherapy and natural medicine practices.
